description: Find files by name/path across connected sources (Google Drive, SharePoint) — including UNSUPPORTED files like CAD drawings (.dwg/.step), images and archives indexed as metadata. Fuzzy-ranked. Each hit includes path, size, modified/last-seen times, source, and up to 3 related parsed sibling documents from the same folder, so you can answer "where is file X, when was it seen last, and what project is it related to".

query.description: File name or path fragment to search for (fuzzy), e.g. "rim cad" or "felge.dwg"

name: gctrl_find_file
